description: Increasing IconSize from 48px to 96px and IconSpacing from 4px to 16px during capture enlarges the icons, gaps, and panel.

assertions.comment: Before I change the setting, the first icon uses the default 48px size.
Before I change the setting, the gaps between icons use the default 4px spacing.
Before I change the settings, the four default-size icons fit in a 220px-wide panel.
After I raise IconSize, the first icon grows to 96px without restarting the dock.
After I raise IconSpacing, the gaps between icons grow to 16px.
The second icon moves to x=112px, visibly combining the 96px icon width with the new 16px gap.
After the layout settles, the panel visibly widens from 220px to 448px for four 96px icons, three 16px gaps, and 16px padding.
